Select approved drugs indicated for breast cancer. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter drug_indication by mesh_id D001943 (breast cancer). Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (INNER JOIN compound_structures), indication_curie (efo_id), indication_label (efo_term), and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
